_comment: Pinterest topic boards for approvalprep.com (owner-approved 1 Nov 2026). Pinterest auto-publish maps ONE RSS feed to ONE board, so each board has its own feed (src/lib/pinfeed-core.mjs pinBoards; functions/pinfeed.xml.js and functions/pinfeed/[board].js). A pin's board comes from its page path (paths, regexes) or, for a /questions/ page, from words in the question; anything unmatched goes to the first board. split_from: pins released before this day were all published to the first board's feed and stay there; the other feeds carry only pins released on or after it, so no pin is published twice. keywords: real Pinterest searches read from Pinterest's own search suggestions on 1 Nov 2026; a pin title that names none of its board's keywords is led with the first one.
